cost_semantics: Catalog estimates, not invoices or complete billing. Includes invalid V2 author/reviewer costs and retained preflights; interrupted/unreported calls and early bootstrap attempts remain unknown.

optional_resource_decision.recurring_observation: The candidate data reference was selectively loaded in three matched data-ledger tasks. This demonstrates use, not a benefit or need for executable helpers.
optional_resource_decision.repository_only_resources: Runner, bounded agent/worker/browser, independent semantic cases/controls, validator, and blind-review stage address recurring measured isolation/oracle/context failures. They do not ship or become skill runtime dependencies.

known_failures_and_limits: Invalid V2: undeclared unknown/variance, timestamp and refresh constraints; homemade accessible names; frozen viewport disagreement; source-only runtime evidence consumer; rejected paired citation schema. All outcomes preserved, never rescored.

Initial bootstrap failures included stale SDK lookup, unsupported bubblewrap flag, AppArmor sandbox refusal, socket-path length, contract/permission forwarding, native date entry, text-scale callback wiring, and event settling. An initial oracle pass had 24 setup-related mismatches before corrections; V2 still proved semantically invalid later. Some early setup code/output/usage was not independently snapshotted; no byte-replayable-history or complete billing claim.

First V3 development validation: nine mismatches. Old evaluator bytes were not independently snapshotted before correction; realized control files, observations and hashes remain. Successful QA2 snapshots all input code before imports.
Source audits found 17 oracle/interface issues; fixes and controls preceded V3 freeze. Zero-font and later inline-style ownership failures were separately reproduced and corrected before freeze.

Current owner reporting encountered wrong JSON field/projection assumptions and grouped-glob basename parsing; corrected without rerunning installation, trials, or scoring. An archive registration import failure was corrected only at the failed step.
Nine V3 projected packets exceeded review bounds; one author trace hit its byte limit; one review aborted. Full captures and passing controls do not repair missing blind evidence.

Only requested/resolved/reported model identity is pinned; vendor weights/build, training exposure, hidden provider caching and server-side billing are unknown. Reviewers share a model family; synthetic small-cohort preferences are not significance or user efficacy.

Namespaces and narrow tools are not a provider-only network firewall. Chrome inner sandbox is disabled only within outer bwrap. Shared host runtime/font identities are checked, not immutable VM snapshots.

Computed font doubling is not browser zoom or full assistive-technology coverage. Identical inline value/priority writes cannot be distinguished. Print API/print-media evidence is not OS-dialog or physical-page proof.
